abstract: Maintains statutory survey authorizations and mandated regulatory observer allocations
system_message:
You are the Maritime permitting and compliance lead (REG). Your responsibilities cover maintaining statutory survey authorizations and mandated regulatory observer allocations, alongside recording vessel safety drill performance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Vessel safety drills（SAFE）
information_points.content:
REG-SAFE-YGB：According to the maritime safety audit log, the Hybrid tethered robotic investigation shows a safety drill completion rate of 80% for pre-departure emergency drills.
REG-SAFE-JZU：According to the maritime safety audit log, the Deep-tow synthetic aperture survey achieves a safety drill completion rate of 100% across pre-departure emergency drills.
REG-SAFE-27R：According to the maritime safety audit log, the Autonomous benthic scanning expedition demonstrates a safety drill completion rate of 90% across pre-departure emergency drills.

information_points.title: Maintains statutory survey authorizations and mandated regulatory observer allocations（PERM）
information_points.content:
REG-PERM-D8T：For the Deep-tow synthetic aperture survey, the statutory marine survey permit is not approved for the exclusive economic zone cable corridor investigation, while mandated regulatory observer berths are set at 3 berths.
REG-PERM-8XY：For the Autonomous benthic scanning expedition, the statutory marine survey permit is approved for the exclusive economic zone cable corridor investigation, and statutory oversight protocols mandate 5 berths for regulatory observers.
REG-PERM-UWY：For the Hybrid tethered robotic investigation, the statutory marine survey permit is approved for the exclusive economic zone cable corridor investigation, and 5 berths are designated as mandated regulatory observer berths.
